title: Inter: Lautaro Martinez hamstring strain - Gazzetta says 5-6 weeks #Shorts
description:
Lautaro's out - and Inter should start Esposito at Bologna.
The Italian Inter press in English, every morning, free: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=45

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED - Inter.it (Oct 15): Lautaro Martinez has "a strain in his left hamstring." The club gave no return date.
REPORTED - Gazzetta dello Sport via FCInter1908 (Oct 16): a "lesione" - a muscle tear - and a layoff of five to six weeks.
REPORTED - Gazzetta dello Sport and Sky Sport Italia (Oct 16): the papers disagree over who starts beside Thuram. Gazzetta says Esposito, Sky says Bonny. Inter have published no lineup.
NEXT UP - Bologna away, Saturday, October 17, Serie A matchday 7, 12:00 PM ET / 18:00 CEST. US TV: Paramount+, CBS Sports Golazo, Peacock.
